acorus-gramineus.name: Acorus gramineus
notes: Section 4: "starting from 80 liters (20 gallons)" -> "bermula dari 80 liter" is fine; but "Hujung daun kering" etc fine. Real issue: Section 8 "nimfa pepatung, nimfa pepatung jarum" - 'dragonfly, damselfly nymphs' is OK, but 'Hydrogen sulfide' fine.
Section 1/8: "Boleh ditanam secara emersed" and "bentuk emergen" are inconsistent; use one term, e.g. "tumbuh timbul (emersed)".

Section 8: "Tumbuhan ini suka pencahayaan yang baik" under heading "Cahaya tidak mencukupi" is fine, but "tanah lembap" for 'wetlands' in section 3 is imprecise; use "tanah bencah/lembap" and "(sebahagiannya atau sepenuhnya tenggelam)" fine.
Section 3: "di paya" for marshes is acceptable; "kawasan tanah lembap" better "kawasan tanah bencah".
Section 8: "Daunnya mengeluarkan bau wangi yang ketara apabila dironyok" - 'dironyok' is awkward; use "diramas".
Section 7: "low-tech" left in English; use "tangki berteknologi rendah (low-tech)".
Section 8: "Kuarantin ... nyahjangkit" fine; "Mencegah poket gas" fine; "Bentuk ini biasa digunakan di sempadan taman" ok.

aegagropila-linnaei.name: Marimo
notes: #13: "udang kara (crayfish)" is a mismatch, as udang kara usually means lobster. Use "udang karang" or "crayfish" for freshwater crayfish.

alternanthera-bettzickiana.name: Alternanthera bettzickiana
notes: Section 3: 'mesh areas' was rendered as 'kawasan paya' (swamp area). The source word is probably a garbled 'marsh', so check it, but the rendering is still a meaning shift. Make it consistent with the source or flag it.

Section 4: 'growth is then moderate to high' was rendered as 'sederhana hingga cepat'. Use 'sederhana hingga tinggi' or 'sederhana hingga pesat' to match the source and the header's 'Kadar pertumbuhan'.

Section 1: 'Growth rate: low' became 'perlahan', which is fine. However, 'Boleh ditanam secara emersed' and 'Pembiakan' leave 'emersed' in English with no local gloss. Use 'secara emers (di atas air)' or 'tumbuh separa darat' for readability.

Section 4: 'In winter it can only survive indoors' was kept as 'Pada musim sejuk'. Malaysia has no winter, so add context such as 'di negara beriklim sederhana' or rephrase for local readers. The 'south-facing window' advice also does not suit Malaysia.
Section 4: 'daun udara' for 'aerial leaves' is awkward. Use 'daun emers' or 'daun yang tumbuh di atas permukaan air'.

Section 4: 'Hardness 1–12 GH' was rendered as 'Kekerasan air 1–12 GH'. This is acceptable, but 'melting' left in English in brackets is fine. 'Substrat ... kedalaman' is fine. 'Gastrousus' in section 1 is non-standard. Use 'penyakit gastrousus' or 'penyakit saluran penghadaman'.
Section 1: 'prophylaxis of dementia' was rendered as 'pencegahan demensia'. This is fine, but 'sebagai sumber khasiat' for 'for nourishment' is slightly off. Use 'sebagai makanan berkhasiat/tonik'.

alternanthera-reineckii.name: Alternanthera reineckii
notes: Item 7: 'Cucuk batang baharu itu ke dalam substrat' – 'cucuk' is slightly odd; use 'tanam' or 'tancapkan'.
Item 7: 'Jika tumbuhan menerima semua keperluan yang diperlukan' is redundant; use 'semua sumber yang diperlukan'.
Item 8: 'melting (cair)' mixes English and Malay; keep one form consistently, e.g. 'mereput/cair (melting)'.
Item 2: 'secara emersed' is left in English; add the Malay term 'timbul/di atas air' (emersed).
Item 12: 'Jambak bunganya terletak pada ketiak' is stiff; 'Perbungaan tumbuh di ketiak daun' is more natural.
Item 9: 'Baja yang berlebihan, paling ringan pun' is awkward; use 'sekurang-kurangnya/paling minimum'.
Item 12: 'Kurang tahan lasak' for 'Not very resilient' is acceptable but the following sentence 'tidak mampu menyerap logam berat tanpa terjejas' is slightly stiff.

alternanthera-reineckii-mini.name: Alternanthera reineckii 'Mini'
notes: Item 2: the source names the plant only as 'Rau dền đỏ mini'. The translation replaces it with "Alternanthera reineckii 'Mini'", which adds a species and cultivar name the source does not give. Use 'Alternanthera Mini' or a neutral phrase such as 'Alternanthera mini merah'.
Item 2: the 'EN' source text is Vietnamese, not English. The Malay is faithful to it, so flag this to the content team rather than treat it as a translation error.

ammannia-crassicaulis.name: Ammannia crassicaulis
notes: Item 3: "8-15 cm wide" refers to the plant/leaf rosette width, and "lebar 8-15 cm" after "Batangnya" implies the stem is 8-15 cm wide; clarify that the plant (not the stem) is 8-15 cm wide, e.g. "dengan lebar tumbuhan 8-15 cm".
Item 2: "ke dalam substrat" is fine, but "daun tersebut akan mati" could be more natural as "daun itu akan mati" or "layu dan mati" (minor).
Item 3: "tumbuhan akuatik ... untuk akuarium" is slightly redundant; "tumbuhan akuarium" is the usual hobby term (minor).
Item 3: "seperti warna koniak" is awkward; consider "berwarna koniak" or "merah keperangan seperti koniak" (minor).

ammannia-gracilis.name: Ammannia gracilis
notes: Minor: "ferum" is stiff for hobbyists; "besi" (iron) is more common in fertiliser talk.
Minor: "Kerana saiznya, peliharalah dalam tangki..." reads abruptly; a smoother version would be "Disebabkan saiznya, tanamlah dalam tangki yang bersaiz sesuai".

anubias-barteri.name: Anubias Coin Leaf
notes: "tangki" is acceptable, but "akuarium" is the more usual term in Malaysia for "di dalam tangki"; consider "di dalam akuarium".
"penggemar akuarium" could be the more common "hobiis akuarium" or "peminat akuarium".

anubias-barteri-mini-coin.name: Anubias Mini Coin
notes: "sama mudah ditanam seperti induknya, dan oleh itu tidak suka cahaya terang": the English is itself odd, but the Malay keeps the illogical "dan oleh itu". Rephrase it to say it is as easy to grow as the parent plant and likewise dislikes bright light, e.g. "... dan seperti induknya, tidak menyukai cahaya terang".

"ditemui di nurseri tumbuhan akuarium Tropica": "found at" is ambiguous. "ditemui di" is acceptable, but "nurseri tumbuhan akuarium" adds "tumbuhan" (plant), which is not in the source. Use "nurseri akuarium Tropica" or "ditemui oleh/di Tropica".
"kuku jari kelingking" is fine, but "Anubias yang paling kecil" loses "very smallest". Use "antara Anubias yang paling kecil sekali".
"Ketinggian: 3 - 10+ cm" is fine. "Asal: kultivar" would be better as "Asal usul: kultivar" or "Jenis: kultivar".
"diikat pada batu": "attached" is better rendered as "dilekatkan/diikat", which is fine. "anak pokok baharu" for "new plants" is acceptable. "batang menjalar (rizom)" is acceptable.

anubias-barteri-nana.name: Anubias nana
notes: Item 2: "dengan sangat perlahan" renders "nhẹ tay" (gently). Use "dengan lembut" or "perlahan-lahan dan lembut"; the tension is the point, not the speed.
Item 2: the source text is Vietnamese, not English. The meaning is still fully kept.

anubias-barteri-petite.name: Anubias Petite
notes: "tangki" is acceptable, but "akuarium" is the more usual hobby term: use "akuarium" instead of "dalam tangki" in item 1 and "tangki yang lebih besar" in item 2.

"tidak cerewet dan juga tidak suka cahaya yang terlalu terang" reads awkwardly. Suggest "tidak cerewet ... dan tidak memerlukan cahaya yang terlalu terang", since the English says it does not appreciate high light intensity.
"sehingga akarnya dapat mencengkam" is fine in meaning. "Tumbuhan yang sesuai" starting the last paragraph is a fragment. Suggest "Tumbuhan ideal untuk landskap mini...".

anubias-barteri-var-barteri.name: Anubias barteri
notes: Item 1: "tangki" is acceptable, but "akuarium" is more natural for hobbyists.
Item 2: "tumbuhan akuatik" was added where the English only says "plant". This is minor and does no harm.
Item 3: "liat dan tegap" is slightly awkward for leaves. Consider "keras dan kukuh" or "tebal dan kuat".

anubias-barteri-var-coffeifolia.name: Anubias Coffeefolia
notes: "Jenis: Berizom" is acceptable, but "Asal: Kultivar" is slightly off; "Asal usul: Kultivar" would read more naturally.
"Spesies Anubias nampaknya tumbuh begitu perlahan sehingga seolah-olah tidak sedar..." is a little stiff. Consider "hingga tidak menyedari bahawa ia telah tenggelam".

anubias-barteri-var-nana.name: Anubias barteri var. nana
notes: "Cameroon" is better written "Cameroon"/"Kamerun" in standard Malay; use "Kamerun" as the Malaysian standard form.
"tumbuh subur dalam semua keadaan" is slightly overstated/unnatural; consider "boleh tumbuh dalam pelbagai keadaan".
"Ketinggian" for plant height is better as "Tinggi"; minor.
"jadi alga yang tumbuh perlahan berpeluang bertapak" is clumsy; consider "membolehkan alga yang tumbuh perlahan melekat pada daun".

anubias-barteri-var-nana-kirin.name: Anubias Nana Kirin
notes: Item 1: "tangki" is acceptable, but "akuarium" would be more consistent with item 2.
Item 3: "bujur telur" is fine, but "berbentuk bujur" or "bujur telur" alone reads more naturally. "diilhamkan daripada naga Asia" could be "diilhamkan oleh naga Asia".

anubias-barteri-var-nana-pinto.name: Anubias Nana Pinto
notes: Minor: 'Keperluan cahaya: Sederhana' is fine, but 'Sederhana' could be 'Sederhana' (ok); consider 'Anubias barteri' italicised as Latin name for consistency.
Minor: 'aquascape' could be 'aquascape' with Malay 'susun atur akuarium' in brackets for clarity.

anubias-gracilis.name: Anubias gracilis
notes: "saiznya akan menjadi agak besar": English says "significant size", so "agak besar" (fairly large) is too weak. Use "sangat besar" or "jauh lebih besar".
"jika ditanam begitu": this is a little loose. "jika dibiarkan tumbuh begitu" or "dengan cara ini" is closer to the source.

aponogeton-boivinianus.name: Aponogeton boivinianus
notes: Item 2: "Kapsul baja" for "Nutrition capsules" is acceptable, but "hujung pucuknya berada pada permukaan tanah" should be "di permukaan substrat" to stay consistent with "lapisan substrat".
Item 3: "serta lebar 30–50 cm" is awkward and unclear. The English is also odd (plant spread). Rephrase as "dan keseluruhan tumbuhan boleh mencapai lebar 30–50 cm".
Item 3: "keperangan" is non-standard. Use "keperang-perangan" or "agak keperangan".
Item 1: "bebawang (bulb)" is fine, but "Ketinggian" could be "Tinggi"; this is a minor point.

aponogeton-longiplumulosus.name: Aponogeton longiplumulosus
notes: Item 2: "Nutrition capsule" translated as "Kapsul baja"; fine in meaning but "kapsul nutrien/baja akar" is more usual. Also "substrat" and "tanah" are mixed for the same thing (bottom layer/soil surface); use one term consistently.
Item 2: "agak mudah dijaga" for "relatively undemanding" is OK, but "tidak memerlukan kualiti air yang khusus" is fine; consider "tidak cerewet" for natural phrasing.

Item 3: "fluted" rendered as "beralun" (wavy); better "bergelombang/beralun" is acceptable, but "sangat cantik dan sesuai disyorkan" is clumsy; rephrase as "tumbuhan menarik yang sesuai disyorkan untuk akuarium besar".
Item 1: "Bebawang/ubi" for "Bulb/onion" is awkward; use "Umbi/bawang" or "Umbi".

aponogeton-madagascariensis.name: Madagascar Lace
notes: "120 liter" (twice): standard Malaysian spelling is "120 liter" in DBP but hobbyists commonly write "litre"/"L"; consider "120 L" for consistency with the style used elsewhere.
"bebawang (bulb)" / "Bebawang": "ubi" or "umbi" is the more natural term for bulb/corm in Malay; "bebawang" reads awkward and is not standard botanical usage.
"sehinggakan ia hanya boleh disyorkan": phrasing is slightly stiff; consider "sehingga hanya sesuai disyorkan".
"kormus": use standard "korm" (corm).
"Pembiakan: Anak pokok melalui bebawang atau biji benih": fine but "biji benih" could simply be "biji".
"ia merosakkan cengkerangnya": ambiguous; clarify that the low-pH water harms the shells ("air itu merosakkan cengkerangnya").
"Jika pH anda menghampiri 7.0" and "pH 5.5 – 7.5": decimal separators use a point; Malay usually uses a comma/point inconsistently, acceptable but be consistent.

azolla.name: Azolla
notes: Item 5: the English source is actually Vietnamese (not English) – the MS is a translation of Vietnamese text; the source mismatch means it cannot be verified as faithful to the given original, and the content (e.g. 'bèo dâu') is a different text from the other items.
Item 4: 'Fairy moss' was rendered 'Azolla' – a name change is acceptable, but also check consistency; 'sekurang-kurangnya 40 liter' should use 'litre' (standard Malaysian spelling).

Item 3: 'sebab itulah ia dipanggil "mosquito fern"' – 'hence the name' is OK, but 'Fairy moss' subject changed to 'Azolla' inconsistently; fine, but 'Biojisimnya boleh berganda setiap beberapa hari' ok.
Item 8: 'udang kara' means lobster/spiny lobster, not crayfish; use 'udang karang' or 'kerang air tawar (crayfish)' – 'udang galah/crayfish' to avoid wrong animal.
Item 8: 'Kisar bersama tanah liat montmorillonit sebagai pengikat' fine, but 'lemas' for fish 'choke' due to low oxygen: better 'sesak nafas/mati lemas akibat kekurangan oksigen'.
Item 1/2/6: 'paku pakis' is redundant; use 'paku-pakis' or 'paku pakis' consistently; 'musim bunga' and 'musim sejuk' are non-Malaysian-context but acceptable.
Item 7: 'Suhu sejuk (−4 °C ke bawah)' ok; 'mati layu' – 'mati ke atas/mati reput' more natural for die back.

bacopa-australis.name: Bacopa australis
notes: Item 2: "dasar tangki" is fine, but "akuarium" and "tangki" are mixed; consider using "dasar akuarium" for consistency (minor).

bacopa-monnieri.name: Bacopa Monnieri Compact
notes: "tangki" in item 1: Malaysian hobbyists normally say "akuarium" for the tank; use "akuarium".
"Kultivar tumbuhan berbatang" in item 3: "culture form" is rendered as "kultivar", which is acceptable, but "tumbuhan berbatang" (stem plant) could be "tumbuhan batang" as hobbyists say it.
"Asal: kultivar": "Origin" is better as "Asal usul".

bacopa-salzmannii.name: Bacopa salzmannii 'Purple'
notes: Item 3: 'tanah lembap' for 'wetlands' is slightly imprecise; 'kawasan tanah bencah/paya' is more natural.
Item 2: 'penggemar akuarium' for 'aquarists' is fine, but 'pembiakannya pun mudah kerana hanya perlu menggunakan keratan batang' is wordy; could be simplified.

blyxa-aubertii.name: Blyxa aubertii
notes: Item 1: "Minimum tank: 80 litres (20 gallons)" is rendered as "80 liter", which is fine. However, "Bamboo plant" and "Roundfruit blyxa" are left as English names. This is acceptable as trade names.

Item 5: "Removing them may turn the annual plant into a perennial one" is translated as "tumbuhan saka". "Saka" means heritage or ancestral and is wrong here. Use "tumbuhan saka" → "tumbuhan saka" is incorrect, so use "tumbuhan saka" → "tumbuhan perenial/saka" only with a correct term such as "tumbuhan saka" replaced by "tumbuhan abadi (perenial)" or "tumbuhan tahunan berbilang".
Item 5: "melting" is left in English in two places ("Daun kuning atau melting", "mungkin melting selepas dipindahkan"). Use "mereput/luruh" or "melting (daun mencair)" on first use.

Item 5: "Inspect it for decaying particles or bad leaves" is rendered as "bahagian yang reput atau daun yang rosak". This is acceptable, but "Fragile leaves break easily during maintenance" → "semasa penjagaan" should be "semasa penyelenggaraan akuarium".

Item 9: "berrabung" is not a Malay word for "ridged". Use "beralur/bergerigi" instead. "Genus Blyxa diwujudkan" should be "diperkenalkan/ditakrifkan". "didokumenkan" should be "didokumenkan/direkodkan".

Item 3: "mendebunga sendiri" should be "mendebunga sendiri / berdebunga sendiri", and "paya bakau yang telah diterokai" for "encroached mangrove land" is a loose rendering. Use "kawasan paya bakau yang dicerobohi".
Item 8: "Udang krai (crayfish)" is not the standard term. Use "udang karang/kerawai air tawar (crayfish)". "Gelembung oksigen kecil (pearling)" is acceptable.

blyxa-japonica.name: Blyxa japonica
notes: Item 6: 'Ia dianggap sukar untuk dihidupkan dalam jangka masa panjang' is awkward; use 'sukar dikekalkan hidup untuk tempoh yang lama'.
Item 6, Planting: 'agak bermasalah' for 'It is problematic at first' is vague; say 'pada mulanya sukar tumbuh/bertapak'.
Item 6, Propagation: 'biji yang boleh bercambah' is fine, but 'Periksa ... bahagian yang reput' changes 'decaying particles' (zarah reput); correct it.
Item 6: 'goyangkan tumbuhan' with 'naik ke atas ... sedut keluar dengan sifon' is slightly unnatural; 'kocak/gerakkan perlahan' and 'ke permukaan' are better.

Item 6, Common problems: 'Melt (daun cair/reput)' and item 7 'mudah melt' leave the English term in the sentence. Use one consistent Malay phrase with (melt) in brackets, e.g. 'mudah reput/cair (melt)'.
Items 1, 4, 7: 'emersed' is left untranslated. Use 'tumbuh timbul (emersed)' or similar.
Items 6 and 8: 'Soil yang disyorkan' and 'root tab' are left in English. Use 'substrat/tanah yang disyorkan' and 'tablet baja akar (root tab)'.
Item 8: 'banyak menyerap makanan melalui akar' is clumsy for 'heavy root feeder'; use 'pemakan akar yang rakus (heavy root feeder)'.
Item 8: 'Untuk CO2 (20-30 mg/l)', 'mg/l' is inconsistent with 'mg/L' used elsewhere; make the unit uniform.
Item 9: 'Udang kara air tawar (crayfish)' and 'cichlid Afrika' are fine, but 'Digemari haiwan' for 'Palatable' is vague; say 'dimakan haiwan lain'.

bolbitis-heteroclita.name: Bolbitis heteroclita
notes: Item 4: '80 litres (20 gallons)' became 'sekurang-kurangnya 80 liter' — the conversion is fine, but 'liter' should be 'liter/L' as used locally (minor).

Item 5: 'Keep the fern from drying out' — 'Pastikan paku pakis ini tidak kering' is fine, but 'jangan tanam rizom ke dalam substrat' is slightly stronger than 'avoid burying'; use 'elakkan menanam rizom...'.
Item 8: 'Wilting ... because their leaves are not adapted' — 'tidak biasa dengan keadaan itu' is vague; use 'tidak sesuai/tidak menyesuaikan diri untuk hidup dalam air'.
Item 8: 'Fertile leaflets' → 'Anak daun subur' is ambiguous; use 'frond subur / daun berspora'.
Item 8: 'udang karang (crayfish)' — 'udang karang' in Malay often means lobster; use 'udang air tawar (crayfish)' or 'kerang/crayfish'.
Item 8: 'herba' for 'herbaceous' ('Daunnya nipis dan herba') is awkward; use 'daun nipis dan bersifat herba/tidak berkayu'.
Item 6: 'daun sering kelihatan hancur' for 'leaf dissolution' — better 'daun sering mereput/larut'.
Item 1/5: 'Saiz dalam akuarium' for 'Aquarium size' is unclear; 'Ketinggian dalam akuarium' fits better since 10–15 cm is plant size.
Item 1: 'Creeping Fern' etc. fine, but 'tangki' vs 'akuarium' used inconsistently; standardise.

bolbitis-heudelotii.name: Bolbitis
notes: "Order: Polypodiales" leaves "Order" in English. Use the Malay taxonomic rank, e.g. "Order/Bangsa", or keep it consistent with the other ranks (Alam, Kelas, Famili).
"Berhati-hati lebih dengan tumbuhan ini" is awkward. Use "Berhati-hatilah dengan tumbuhan ini" or "Kendalikan dengan lebih berhati-hati".
"frond" is left in English throughout. Consider "frond (pelepah daun)" at first mention. Likewise, "melting" could be "melting (daun hancur/reput)" at first mention.

bucephalandra-diabolica.name: Bucephalandra Kedagang
notes: "varian Red Bucephalandra": the English is "the Red variety of Bucephalandra", so the word order is wrong. Use "varian Red bagi Bucephalandra" or "Bucephalandra varian Red".
"Apabila tenggelam di dalam air" is slightly awkward for "When immersed". Use "Apabila ditanam secara terendam" (emersed vs submersed growth), or "Apabila terendam sepenuhnya".
"keluarga Bucephalandra": Bucephalandra is a genus, but the source says "family". Keep it as is, or use "genus" if you correct it. This is a minor point.

bucephalandra-pygmaea.name: Bucephalandra pygmaea 'Wavy Green'
notes: "tangki": the usual hobby term in Malaysia is "akuarium", which the text itself uses elsewhere. Use "dalam akuarium".
"Keperluan CO2: rendah": this is fine as written. Consider "Keperluan CO2" to match the "Keperluan cahaya" pattern if you want to be consistent. It is minor.
"tidak boleh ditimbus": "ditimbus" is understandable. A more natural hobby phrasing is "tidak boleh dikambus/ditanam dalam substrat". It is minor.
"tenggelam dalam air" for "immersed leaves": the usual hobby sense is leaves grown underwater. "daun yang tumbuh di bawah air (submersed)" would be clearer. It is minor.

bucephalandra-sordidula.name: Bucephalandra sp. 'Blue'
notes: "Bahagian tengah atau depan tangki": 'midground or foreground' is more naturally 'tengah atau latar depan'. Minor.
"yang sudah berpengalaman" is slightly awkward. Consider 'pemain hobi berpengalaman'. Minor.
"Bentuknya kekal kemas walaupun jarang dipangkas" slightly changes 'minimal trimming'. Consider 'dengan pemangkasan yang minimum'. Minor.

bucephalandra-sp.name: Bucephalandra Dark Leaf
notes: Item 2: "tumbuhan karpet" narrows "cây nền" (ground or foreground plants). Use "tumbuhan latar depan/tumbuhan dasar" or "tumbuhan yang ditanam dalam substrat".

bucephalandra-sp-dark-skeleton-king.name: Bucephalandra Dark Skeleton King
notes: Item 1: Source spells 'Bucephelandra' but the translation silently changes it to 'Bucephalandra'. This is a correction, so the Latin name is not kept as written. It is minor.

Item 1: 'secara emersed (separa timbul)' leaves English in place. Use 'timbul di atas air (emersed)' or similar, for example 'tumbuh timbul'. Likewise 'tenggelam dalam air' could be 'tenggelam (submersed)'.

Item 2: The English source is actually Vietnamese and was not in English. The MS follows the content faithfully, so there is no real problem. Note that 'tumbuhan epifit yang hidup melekat' adds 'epifit', which is not in the source (the source says 'cây sống bám'). It is acceptable but slightly redundant.
Item 2: 'penyepit' is non-standard for aquascaping tweezers. Use 'forsep' or 'penyepit (tweezers)'.
Item 2: 'mengikat pokok' and 'tanam semuanya sekali gus' are fine, but 'rendam secara berasingan ... supaya pokok biasa dengan air' is awkward. Use 'supaya pokok menyesuaikan diri dengan air'.

Item 2: 'Tangki baharu yang hanya ditanam dengan tumbuhan yang tumbuh perlahan, walaupun ditanam banyak' is clumsy. Rephrase to 'walaupun ditanam banyak, tangki baharu yang hanya mempunyai tumbuhan perlahan membesar mudah diserang alga'.
Item 3: 'tangki berlampu malap' is an awkward rendering of 'low light'. Use 'cahaya rendah'. 'ikan laga' is fine for betta.

bucephalandra-sp-degori.name: Bucephalandra Degori
notes: Item 1: the Latin genus name is changed from "Bucephelandra" (source) to "Bucephalandra". Latin names should stay as in the source, even though the new spelling is the correct botanical one.
Item 1: "separa timbul (emersed)" adds "separa" (semi). The source says emersed, meaning grown out of water, so use "timbul (emersed)" or "tumbuh di atas permukaan air".
Item 2: the source text is Vietnamese, not English. The Malay follows it faithfully, so no translation error to fix here.

bucephalandra-sp-mini-melawi.name: Bucephalandra Mini Melawi
notes: Item 1: the source spells the genus "Bucephelandra" but the Malay has "Bucephalandra". This is a correct spelling fix, but the Latin name no longer matches the source, so check it was intended.
Item 1: "Portion" is rendered as "Saiz". "Saiz" suggests plant size, so "Kuantiti" or "Bahagian" would fit better for single, double or triple rhizome portions.
Item 2: the source text is Vietnamese, not English. The Malay follows it faithfully, so I found no meaning errors.

bucephalandra-sp-needle-leaf.name: Bucephalandra Needle Leaf
notes: 'pygmaeae' was changed to 'pygmaea' — keep the Latin name unchanged as in the source ('pygmaeae').
'cahaya yang lebih sedikit terang' is awkward and unclear; use 'cahaya yang sedikit lebih terang'.
'memerlukan keadaan yang sedikit lebih tinggi' is awkward; use 'keperluan yang sedikit lebih tinggi' or 'lebih menuntut'.
'kedua-duanya banyak persamaan' is missing a verb; use 'kedua-duanya mempunyai banyak persamaan'.
'tangki' is acceptable, but 'akuarium' is the more common hobby term; consider 'dalam akuarium'.

bucephalandra-sp-red.name: Bucephalandra sp. 'Red'
notes: "Berizom" is acceptable but "Jenis: Berizom" would be clearer as "Jenis: Berrizom (rhizomatous)"; consider "berakar rizom".
"tumbuh lebih kurang secara epifit" is awkward; use "biasanya tumbuh agak epifit" or "hampir epifit".

"Keperluan cahaya: rendah" fine, but "Ini akan menyebabkan" could be "Ini akan menyebabkan tumbuhan itu reput dan mati" -> more natural "Perbuatan ini boleh menyebabkan..." (English 'will' is firm, minor).
"daun yang tumbuh di bawah air" for 'submerse leaves' is fine; "merah seperti kulit" is slightly awkward; consider "bertekstur seperti kulit, berwarna merah".

bucephalandra-sp-round-leaf.name: Bucephalandra Round Leaf
notes: Item 2: the English source is actually Vietnamese, but the Malay follows it faithfully; no fix needed there.
Item 2: 'rendam berasingan dalam air' loses the 'chậu' sense and is slightly awkward; 'keluarkan sahaja dari pasu' is added, so say 'tanggalkan sahaja' to stay closer to 'gỡ ra'.
Item 2: 'Tempat letak' is awkward; use 'Penempatan' or 'Kedudukan tanaman'.
Item 2: 'lebihan nutrien' for 'phân dư' is acceptable, but 'tangki' and 'akuarium' are mixed; use one term consistently.
Item 3: 'secara emersed' leaves English in place; use 'timbul di atas air (emersed)' or similar.
Item 3: 'akuarium bertumbuhan' is non-standard; use 'akuarium tanaman berair' or 'akuarium tumbuhan'.
Item 3: the source spells 'Bucephelandra', but the Malay writes 'Bucephalandra', the correct form, so no change is needed.

bucephelandra-sp.name: Bucephalandra Silver
notes: "tumbuh tenggelam di dalam air" is slightly awkward; "tumbuh secara terendam (submersed)" is more natural hobby wording.
"tumbuh di atas permukaan air (emersed)" is imprecise; "tumbuh secara emers (di atas air)" is better.
"tangki akuarium bertumbuhan" is unnatural for planted tank; use "akuarium tumbuhan berair" or "akuarium bertanaman (planted tank)".
"sangat sesuai ... dan amat sesuai" repeats the same intensity; vary the wording, e.g. "sesuai sekali" for the second.

cabomba-aquatica.name: Cabomba aquatica
notes: "tangki" is acceptable but "akuarium" is the more common term for a hobbyist's tank; consider "dalam akuarium".
"asingkan kepada pokok-pokok yang berasingan" is awkward; use "asingkan kepada pokok individu".
"setiap batang boleh menjadi 5–8 cm lebar" is awkward; use "setiap batang boleh mencapai lebar 5–8 cm".
"Ia spesies Cabomba yang paling mudah dijaga" is slightly loose; "paling kurang kompleks/tidak cerewet" is closer to the source. Add "yang" and use "Ia merupakan spesies Cabomba yang ...".
"Di tempat asalnya, tumbuhan ini dimakan": the English says "locally", so "setempat" would be more faithful than the added "origin" idea.

"Tanam ... ke dalam substrat dengan sedikit jarak" is ambiguous: the English means plant with some depth into the substrate. Clarify as "tanam sedikit dalam ke dalam substrat" and keep "jarak" separate if spacing is meant.

cabomba-furcata.name: Cabomba Merah
notes: Item 2: "dengan baja cecair terus ke dalam air" adds "cecair" (liquid), which the source doesn't say. Use "pembajaan terus ke dalam turus air" or "baja terus ke dalam air".

cabomba-sp.name: Cabomba
notes: Item 9: "Crayfish" is left in English; use the local term "udang karang" (crayfish).
Item 7: "melting" and "cair" are used inconsistently in the same bullet; use one term, for example "melting (reput/cair)".

caloglossa-beccarii.name: Red Moss
notes: Section 7 Flow: "arus air yang perlahan adalah optimum" — English says gentle current is optimal but not mandatory; fine, but "Sekali lagi, spektrum cahaya lebih penting" changes "I would repeat"; acceptable. Main issue below.
Section 10 Size: the English gives "2 – 5 inches (5 – 10 cm)"; the conversion is fine, but in Section 1 "Saiz dalam akuarium: 5–10 cm" is fine too, so no change needed there.
Section 6 Temperature: the English range 75–84°F (24–29°C) is fine, but "Salinity ... (<5pmm)" keeps the source typo "pmm"; correct it to "ppm" (or "ppt") rather than copying it.

Section 8: "Caloglossa menjadi makanan kegemaran sesetengah ikan" — the English says "treat" (a snack that fish eat, so it can get eaten). Clarify that some fish like cichlids will eat/graze it, which is the care warning.

Section 10: "Tanpa aliran udara yang mencukupi" and "sediakan aliran udara" — "airflow" in an aquarium is better rendered as water circulation ("pergerakan/aliran air"); "aliran udara" implies air movement and may mislead.
Section 10: "Ia bercabang secara bercabang dua" is redundant; use "bercabang dua seperti garpu".
Section 10: "Jenis alga lain boleh mengatasi Red algae" is fine, but "Sebaik sahaja ia stabil dalam tangki" should read "sebaik sahaja ia sebati/mantap"; minor.
Section 7: "Aquarium berlampu malap" for "low-light" is fine, but "CO2 ... tahap tinggi sangat berbahaya" is OK; no change.

cardamine-lyrata.name: Cardamine lyrata
notes: Item 3: "musim panas" is non-standard for Malaysia (no summer); use e.g. "pada musim panas (di kawasan beriklim sederhana)" or rephrase as "semasa cuaca panas".
Item 3: "tumbuhan akuarium yang biasa dikenali" is awkward for "familiar aquarium plant"; use "tumbuhan akuarium yang popular/lazim digunakan".
Item 2: "batangnya memanjang dengan daun yang jarang" is a wordy rendering of "leggy"; use "batang menjadi kurus dan panjang (leggy)".

ceratophyllum-demersum.name: Hornwort
notes: Item 4: 'musim luruh' / 'musim bunga' / 'musim panas' are temperate seasons that Malaysian readers rarely use; consider adding a short gloss, e.g. 'musim luruh (autumn)'.
Item 3: 'order Ceratophyllales' leaves 'order' in English; use 'order' in Malay form, e.g. 'tertib Ceratophyllales' (minor).

ceratopteris-thalictroides.name: Water Sprite
notes: Item 7, Uses: "cepat mengatasi kebanyakan alga dalam persaingan nutrien" adds "nutrien", which the English does not say. Use "cepat mengatasi kebanyakan alga dalam persaingan" or "menyaingi alga dengan cepat".

Item 7, Tankmates: "mystery snail", "ramshorn" and "Japanese trapdoor" are left in English. Local hobbyists may know them by Malay or common names such as "siput ramshorn", so check the terms. This is minor.

crinum-calamistratum.name: Crinum calamistratum
notes: Item 2: the source text is Vietnamese, not English. The Malay follows it faithfully, but the source should be checked.
Item 3: "memerlukan kurang cahaya" is slightly awkward. "memerlukan cahaya yang lebih sedikit" or "keperluan cahayanya lebih rendah" reads more naturally.

crinum-thaianum.name: Crinum thaianum
notes: "bebawang (bulb)": acceptable, but "ubi/umbi" is the more common botanical term for bulb in Malay; consider "umbi (bulb)".
"menghantar tangkai bunga": literal; more natural is "mengeluarkan tangkai bunga".
"tersendiri" for "distinctive": better "unik" or "istimewa".

cryptocoryne-albida.name: Cryptocoryne albida 'Brown'
notes: Minor: "tangki" is acceptable but "akuarium" is more consistent with item 2 ("dalam akuarium").

cryptocoryne-beckettii.name: Cryptocoryne beckettii 'Petchii'
notes: "Daunnya cantik, panjangnya 10-15 cm": the English says the leaf margins are fluted and the leaves are 10-15 cm long. Rephrase to make clear it is the leaf margins that are slightly fluted, e.g. "daun sepanjang 10-15 cm dengan tepi daun yang cantik dan sedikit beralun".
"Daunnya bertukar menjadi warna coklat zaitun gelap": slightly awkward. Use "Daun menjadi coklat zaitun gelap dengan bahagian bawah berwarna ungu".
"Ketinggian" for plant height is acceptable, but "Tinggi" is more natural in a hobby spec list.

cryptocoryne-crispatula.name: Cryptocoryne crispatula
notes: Item 3: "sebelum mula tumbuh dengan betul-betul aktif" is awkward; use "sebelum pertumbuhan benar-benar bermula" or "tumbuh dengan aktif".
Item 3: "tangki" is acceptable, but "akuarium" is more common among Malaysian hobbyists; consider it.
Item 3: "supaya daunnya boleh terapung" adds a purpose clause; the original says "from where", so use "di mana daunnya boleh terapung" or similar.
Item 3: "cerewet" is slightly colloquial for "demanding"; "tidak terlalu menuntut" or "mudah dijaga" is neutral.

cryptocoryne-nurii.name: Cryptocoryne nurii 'Rose Maiden'
notes: "tangki" is acceptable, but "akuarium" is the more common term for the tank in Malaysian hobby usage.
"anak pokok selalunya muncul" adds the idea of plantlets; the English only says runners show up far from the mother plant. Rephrase as "stolon ... selalunya muncul agak jauh dari pokok induk".

cryptocoryne-parva.name: Cryptocoryne parva
notes: Item 10: "dilindungi oleh tumbuhan lain" for "overshadowed" reads as 'protected'. Use "dinaungi" or "ditutupi" instead.

Item 8 and item 6: "kurang berkemungkinan tumbuh dengan baik" and "kurang berkemungkinan menyebabkan" are stiff calques. Use "kurang sesuai" or "sukar tumbuh dengan baik", and "lebih jarang menyebabkan".
Item 11: "Sepasu pokok berharga beberapa ringgit" turns "a few dollars" into ringgit. This is acceptable localisation, but check that the price range is still plausible.

cryptocoryne-undulata.name: Cryptocoryne undulata 'Broad Leaves'
notes: 'Ia juga membesar lebih besar' is redundant; use 'Ia juga tumbuh lebih besar' or 'Saiznya juga lebih besar'.

'the single rosette becomes 10-20 cm wide' became 'setiap roset boleh mencapai lebar 10–20 cm'. 'single' is changed to 'setiap' (each), and 'boleh' (can) is added. Use 'roset tunggal ... mencapai lebar 10–20 cm'.

cryptocoryne-usteriana.name: Cryptocoryne usteriana
notes: "di dalam tangki": in Malaysian hobby usage "akuarium" is the more natural term than "tangki" (e.g. "di dalam akuarium").
"permukaan yang timbul berbonggol": awkward and redundant. Use "permukaan berbonggol" or "permukaan beremboss".
"merah burgundy": use "merah anggur" or "merah marun", which is more natural.
"sangat tahan dengan air yang agak beralkali": awkward. Use "sangat tahan terhadap air yang agak beralkali".

"stolon (runner)": the runner is technically a stolon, so this is acceptable. Check that "Dengan cahaya dan baja yang mencukupi" is not stronger than the source's "good light and fertilization". "Baik" would be closer to the source than "mencukupi".

cryptocoryne-wendtii.name: Cryptocoryne wendtii 'Green'
notes: Item 3: "sangat terancam (critically endangered)" would be more exact as "terancam kritikal", the standard IUCN term in Malay.
Item 8: "dalam beberapa minggu" for "in a couple of weeks" is looser than the source. "dalam masa dua minggu" or "dua hingga tiga minggu" is closer.

Items 2 and 12: "gangsa" for "bronze" and "Tahap kesukaran" are acceptable. Several English terms (runner, melt, emersed, submersed) are left in English without a consistent gloss. Use one consistent form, for example "emersed (timbul)" on first mention only.

cryptocoryne-x-willisii.name: Cryptocoryne willisii
notes: "tangki" is acceptable, but "akuarium" is the more usual term for a fish tank in Malaysian hobby usage; consider "di dalam akuarium".

cyperus-helferi.name: Cyperus helferi
notes: "tangki" in item 1: Malaysian hobbyists normally say "akuarium" for the tank, so use "di dalam akuarium".
"tumbuhan akuatik di bawah air" is redundant. Use "tumbuhan akuatik" or "tumbuhan dalam air".
"rosetnya selebar": "roset" is acceptable but could be clearer, e.g. "rumpun berbentuk roset selebar 15–25 cm".

dracaena-sanderiana.name: Buluh Bertuah
notes: Item 2: "Alam" for Kingdom and "Order" are acceptable, but "Order" could be "Order/Tertib" for consistency. This is optional and minor.
Item 3: "suhu yang panas" is slightly strong for "warm temperatures". "suhu yang hangat" or "suhu yang suam" reads more naturally.

echinodorus-angustifolia.name: Echinodorus Vesuvius
notes: Items 2, 3 and 4: "kuntum bunga" means an open flower. For "flower buds" use "kudup bunga".

echinodorus-aquartica.name: Echinodorus 'Aquartica'
notes: "Asal" for Origin is slightly terse; "Asal usul" or "Asalan" would be more natural (minor).
"tumbuhan kultivasi" is slightly awkward; "tumbuhan kultivar" or "tumbuhan ternak/kacukan" is more natural (minor).

echinodorus-cordifolius.name: Echinodorus Cordifolius Fluitans
notes: "Mexico" should be "Mexico" in Malay is acceptable; but "Asal: Amerika Utara" in item 1 is fine—no issue; minor: "Roset" is OK.
"Echinodorus dari Mexico yang tumbuh agak cepat berbanding yang lain" is slightly awkward; better "Echinodorus dari Mexico yang agak cepat membesar".
"memang cantik sebagai hiasan" is a little awkward; use "sangat menarik sebagai hiasan".
"instead" nuance is lost in the last sentence: add "sebaliknya" ("sebaliknya ia akan mengeluarkan daun besar betul-betul di bawah permukaan air").

echinodorus-grisebachii.name: Amazon Sword
notes: "crown" is left in English throughout (table, items 2 and 6). Use a Malay term such as "pangkal rosette/mahkota", with (crown) in brackets on first use.
"Malaysian trumpet snail", "Japanese trapdoor snail" and "mystery snail" are left in English. Use "siput trumpet Malaysia" etc., for consistency with "siput ramshorn" and "siput nerite".
"ghost shrimp", "bamboo shrimp" and "vampire shrimp" are left in English while "udang Amano" is localised. Make this consistent, e.g. "udang hantu", "udang buluh".

echinodorus-grisebachii-tropica.name: Echinodorus Tropica
notes: "sedikit berkedut" for "slightly bullate": bullate means blistered or puckered (berlepuh/bergelembung). "berkedut" means wrinkled, so the meaning is slightly shifted.
"Origin: Cultivar" became "Asal: Kultivar": this is acceptable, but "Roset" for Rosulate is fine only if consistent. Consider "berroset" for the type.
"mudah dikenali" for "distinctive": better "unik" or "tersendiri".

echinodorus-ozelot.name: Echinodorus 'Ozelot'
notes: "dalam tangki": "akuarium" is the more usual hobby term in Malaysia ("tangki" is acceptable but less common).
"Ozelot" paragraph: "cahaya yang malap" is slightly loose for "low light intensity"; "keamatan cahaya rendah" is closer.

echinodorus-ozelot-green.name: Echinodorus Ozelot Green
notes: Item 2: the source text is Vietnamese, not English. The Malay is faithful, but the source should be checked. The "Echinodorus" Latin name is added where the source only says "Kiếm" (sword plant), which is acceptable but worth confirming.
Item 2: "bahagian belakang atau tengah aquascape" is a little awkward. "latar belakang atau tengah akuarium" would read more naturally.

echinodorus-red-diamond.name: Echinodorus 'Red Diamond'
notes: Item 3: 'appeared as a culture' rendered as 'tanaman kultur' is slightly unclear; consider 'sebagai kultivar/hasil kultur tisu'.
Item 3: 'tumbuhan tunggal' is acceptable, but 'tumbuhan solo' or 'tumbuhan utama (specimen plant)' is more common among local hobbyists.

echinodorus-reni.name: Echinodorus 'Reni'
notes: Item 2: "tidak cerewet" for "unpretentious" is slightly off in tone; "tidak memilih" or "mudah dijaga" would be more natural for a plant.
Item 1: "roset selebar 15-25 cm" is fine, but you could add "berbentuk roset" for smoother reading (optional).

echinodorus-rose.name: Echinodorus 'Rosé'
notes: Item 3: 'pasu segi empat 9 cm' is slightly ambiguous; consider 'pasu persegi 9 cm' or '9 × 9 cm'.
Item 3: 'pokok induk' is acceptable, but 'tumbuhan induk' is more consistent with the rest of the text.

echinodorus-tenellus.name: Pygmy Chain Sword
notes: Item 1: "Saiz tangki minimum: 40 liter" – "liter" is the English/Indonesian spelling; Malaysian standard is "liter"/"liter" in DBP but hobbyists commonly write "L" or "liter". Minor; consider "40 L".
Item 3: "Runner mungkin tercabut dan terapung keluar dari substrat" – the English says runners may jump out of the substrate; "terapung" (float) is added detail. Use "tercabut keluar dari substrat".

Item 3: "Dos makronutrien ... untuk mengelakkan kekurangan nutrien yang menyebabkan batang berubah warna" – awkward; "dos" for dosing is acceptable, but "kekurangan" followed by a long clause reads stiffly. Consider "menyebabkan batang pudar warna".
Item 3: "Daun mudah ditumbuhi alga" – "mudah" (easily) is added; the English says leaves attract algae under excessive light.
Item 2: "famili water plantain" – mixed English; prefer "famili Alismataceae (water plantain)".

egeria-densa.name: Elodea
notes: Item 2: "bank biji benih dalam sedimen" is redundant (biji benih); use "bank benih dalam sedimen".
Item 2: "negara bahagian" for "states" is stiff and may confuse Malaysian readers (who read it as "negeri"); say "banyak negeri/wilayah (di AS)" or "banyak kawasan".

eleocharis-acicularis.name: Hairgrass
notes: "mula menjadi" / "benar-benar membesar" (catch on / get going) is slightly awkward. Use "mula bertapak" and "mula tumbuh dengan pesat".
"tidak mengapa jika ditekan ke bawah" is vague for "fine to hold down". Say that the portions need to be pressed or held down gently so they don't float up.

eleocharis-montevidensis.name: Eleocharis montevidensis
notes: Item 2: "basic and low maintenance" rendered as "ringkas dan mudah dijaga" — "ringkas" is a weak/odd rendering of "basic"; use e.g. "mudah/asas dan tidak memerlukan banyak penjagaan".
Item 2: "in transparent wads" translated as "dalam rumpun yang lapang dan lut sinar" — "yang lapang" (spacious/open) is added and not in the source; use "dalam rumpun lut sinar" only.
Item 2: "Each straw" rendered "batangnya" (stem); acceptable but "helai/batang" fine — keep consistent.
Item 1: "Light demand"/"CO2 demand" as "Keperluan" is fine, but "20–30+ cm" kept; no issue.

eleocharis-pusilla.name: Eleocharis pusilla 'Mini'
notes: Item 2: the English source is actually Vietnamese, not English, so the source text is unusual; the Malay translation is faithful to it but cannot be checked against a true English original.

Item 4: 'was given to Tropica by Thomas Barr' is changed to 'diperoleh daripada Thomas Barr'. The Tropica link is dropped, so a fact is omitted. Say it was given to Tropica by Thomas Barr from the USA.
Item 4: 'has even lower growth' is rendered 'tumbuh lebih rendah lagi'. This is acceptable, but 'closed cup' becoming 'cawan tertutup' is fine; ensure Tropica is retained.
Item 2: 'tangki' is used for the tank. Prefer 'akuarium' in a Malaysian hobby handbook, although 'tangki' is understood.
Item 3: the 'Needs light ... however' sentence is slightly awkward. Consider 'Memerlukan cahaya yang baik untuk prestasi optimum, namun ...'.

eriocaulon-cinereum.name: Eriocaulon cinereum
notes: Item 10: "mendebunga" is non-standard; use "mendebungakan" or "proses pendebungaan".
Item 3: "dua keturunan" for "lineages" could be clearer as "dua salasilah (lineage)".

fissidens-fontanus.name: Phoenix Moss
notes: "daun halus" for "down": "tight deep green down" means fine feathery/downy growth; "daun halus" is acceptable but "tersusun rapat" adds a leaf-arrangement claim. Consider "bulu halus hijau tua yang padat".
"berbentuk seperti bulu pelepah" is awkward; use "berbentuk seperti bulu burung" or "bak bulu pelepah" for "featherlike".
"diikat pada kayu": "attaching" is fine, but "kayu" should be "kayu apung/driftwood" if wood pieces are meant; "Keperluan cahaya" is acceptable.

glossostigma-elatinoides.name: Glosso
notes: "tangki bertumbuhan" is awkward for "planted tanks"; use "tangki bertanaman" or "planted tank".
"famili Phrymaceae": the English gloss "lopseed family" is dropped; optionally add "famili lopseed".
"Tanam dengan penyepit, tanam anak pokok hingga..." repeats "tanam"; rephrase as "Tanam dengan penyepit dan tanam anak pokok sehingga hanya daun kelihatan".

gratiola-viscidula.name: Gratiola viscidula
notes: "tumbuhan batang" is acceptable, but "tumbuhan berbatang" is more natural (optional)
"tumbuhan karpet" could be "tumbuhan permaidani" or "karpet" for carpeting; "almost carpeting" is slightly altered to "like a carpet plant" (minor)

helanthium-bolivianum.name: Echinodorus Quadricostatus
notes: "Sebelum ini dikenali sebagai Echinodorus 'Quadricostatus'" repeats the name given at the start of the text (a source quirk); it is faithful, but check that it reads clearly.
"dasar tangki" is fine, but "substrat" or "dasar akuarium" is more usual in the hobby.
"Asal: Amerika Selatan" would read more naturally as "Asal usul" or "Asalan".
"Roset" for Rosulate is acceptable, but "berroset" is more natural.
"nutrien mikro" is better written as "mikronutrien" or "nutrien surih".

helanthium-tenellum.name: Helanthium tenellum 'Green'
notes: Item 1: "tangki" is acceptable, but "akuarium" is more natural for the hobby context ("dalam akuarium").
Item 2: "lapisan dasar" could be the more hobby-standard "substrat".

hemianthus-callitriodes.name: Hemianthus callitriodes
notes: Section 2: 'first described and collected' is rendered as 'mula-mula dikumpul dan dihuraikan' – the order is reversed, and 'dihuraikan' is odd for a botanical description (use 'diperihalkan'). Minor.

Section 2: 'Order Lamiales' is left as 'Order' in the classification; use 'Order' consistently or 'Bangsa'. 'Alam Plantae' for Kingdom is acceptable but inconsistent with the English-form 'Klad'. Minor.
Section 5, Dry start Pros: 'light (without water, even low light can be enough)' is translated as 'pencahayaan', so the benefit is lost. Use 'cahaya: tanpa air, cahaya rendah pun mungkin cukup'.
Section 5, Problems: 'iron deficiency (such as iron and potassium)' is translated literally, so the illogical source wording is kept. Make it 'kekurangan nutrien (seperti ferum dan kalium)'.
Section 5, Dry start: 'Plant with tweezers' is repeated after the planting step. Fine, but 'sebelum kitaran nitrogen tangki dimulakan' is an added gloss. Use 'sebelum tangki dikitarkan (cycling)'.

Section 5, Care: 'Introduce algae-eating species' is translated as 'spesies pemakan alga' without saying which animals. Acceptable, but 'Care' says 'Gently brush or stir ... with tweezers', and 'kuis' is unnatural. Use 'kacau'.
Section 7: 'Fertilisers such as Flourish Excel are well accepted' is translated as 'sesuai digunakan'. Flourish Excel is a carbon supplement, not a fertiliser; keep as in the source.
Section 8: 'Hostile species such as ... rainbowfish' is rendered 'ganas'. 'Hostile' fits poorly; use 'agresif'. 'ikan laga' for bettas is fine.

Section 3: 'foreground (midground)' is translated as 'latar depan (latar tengah)' – fine. 'Kedudukan dalam tangki' – 'Kuarantin ... nimfa pepatung dan pepatung jarum' is fine. Section 1: 'Fertilisers: appreciated' → 'digemari' is odd; use 'disyorkan' or 'dialu-alukan'.

heteranthera-zosterifolia.name: Stargrass
notes: Item 7: "Bahagian bawah kurus dan tidak berdaun" is awkward for "Leggy bottom leaves"; use e.g. "Daun bawah gugur / batang bawah gondol".
Item 7: "terlindung daripada cahaya" for "shading" is slightly awkward; "teduhan berlebihan" is more natural.
Item 7: "Jangan lekatkan dengan gam pada kayu hanyut" is wordy; "Jangan lekatkan pada kayu hanyut" would be more natural.
Item 5/9: "liter" is the standard spelling in Malaysia ("liter"), but you could also write "L" for consistency with the other unit symbols.
Item 9: "ruang air" for "water column" is non-standard; use "turus air" or "air akuarium".
Item 9: "akarnya tidak dalam" is awkward; use "akarnya tidak menembusi dalam".

hydrocotyle-leucocephala.name: Brazilian Pennywort
notes: Item 2: "menjalar seperti tumbuhan menjalar" is repetitive. Rephrase, e.g. "menjalar seperti pokok pemanjat".

hydrocotyle-tripartita.name: Hydrocotyle tripartita 'Japan'
notes: "cahaya yang mencukupi" for "good light" slightly weakens the meaning; consider "cahaya yang baik" or "cahaya yang terang".
"Jenis: tumbuhan batang": "tumbuhan berbatang" or "tumbuhan batang (stem plant)" is more common among hobbyists.

hydrocotyle-verticillata.name: Pegaga Air

limnophila-hippuridoides.name: Limnophila hippuridoides
